        "All5 owned file diffs read in full. OpenPGP stops rebuilding a hard-coded subset of compose fields and instead requires/stores prepared headers passed through the shared compose-security interface. MimeMessage obtains the part header string once, writes it as outer headers and passes the same string only at depth0 when a compose-secure object exists. The removed address/news/subject/references reconstruction is not retained as current behavior.",
        "IDL changes recipients from string to AUTF8String and adds separate AUTF8String headers. Native S/MIME receives const nsACString references and adjusts its recipient-address extraction wrapper; its optional prepared-header parameter is unused in the selected current file. This compatibility change does not establish that S/MIME starts signing every header. The beginCryptoEncapsulation receiver is nsIMsgComposeSecure, distinct from earlier removed send-interface methods; existing focused claim reused.",
        "The title protected-headers draft compliance is an intent, not independently verified standard compliance. This source analysis does not establish every header present in every delivery mode or crypto output correctness. Exact owned unchanged MimePart helper emits its existing Map without an exclusion parameter. Current accepted helper later clones/removes bcc/resent-bcc when requested and current crypto caller requests true, while recipients still include Bcc separately. Current OpenPGP writer additionally has unobtrusive/hp/original-subject branches that are later phases, not attributed to this owned patch. No crypto/signature/EML/decryption tests changed or run; imported header-emitter internals and external draft body are bounded.",
        "Read complete Bug0–10 plus full own review,9actual inline bodies and no summary edits. Initial C++-adds-Date theory is corrected1as dead code and3points to MimeMessage JS; proposed C++ keep-existing-Date plan is not adopted fact. Author explains removing selective inner-header reconstruction in favor of prepared outer headers. Actual owned source adopts stored headers, concrete name, string truth check, nullable-header JSDoc, UTF8string signature and removal of obsolete C++ comment. The recipient-already-encoded question remains explicitly unanswered: author says I do not know and cites subsequent EncodedHeader use, which is not proof of incoming encoding. Scope comment types accordingly.",
        "Owned landing occurs with ongoing/failed builds; later Harbormaster completion is historical only. Bug8reports encrypted Subject shown as ellipsis after Daily0827 and9confirms/splits1990166; delayed display can mask detection per10. Keep that report distinct from selected accepted originalSubject repair and unobtrusive/Bcc-filter phases, without claiming this audit re-executed decryption or proved cause of every later1999642/2037358 metadata regression. External protected-headers draft/old dependencies remain bounded; title and acceptance do not independently establish standards/security correctness."
